🗓 TAWG Daily Catch-up — 2026-08-26 23:00 UTC → 2026-08-27 23:00 UTC

🤝 What moved

**recompute-kit**
Conformance coverage and serializer-binding infrastructure moved forward across multiple contributions today.
• Zexo opened a hermetic conformance gate for `dex-calldata-v0` in recompute-kit, closing the gap between the existing spec and its test vectors and giving the group a reproducible check for that calldata variant. [PR #15](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/15)
• Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) shared a new conformance commit for the integrations path, keeping implementation aligned with the spec and letting coverage gaps surface before they compound. [tg:tawg:3454]
• Pavlo reviewed the chain logic in a recompute-kit pull request, confirming that two required negatives are now genuinely executable and removing an ambiguity that could have caused silent conformance failures downstream. [PR #25 comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/25#issuecomment-5445698300)
• Merlini introduced an owner-neutral binding-record registry with schema and semantics for serializer bindings, giving other contributors a foundation they can extend without coordinating ownership. [PR #24](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/24)

**ERC-8354**
A merge milestone was reached and a compatibility path for related repositories is now on the table.
• Zidan (@mzf11125) shared a new ERC they are co-authoring with Zexo and previous collaborators, inviting the group to review and comment early. [tg:tawg:3448]
• Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) recognized the upstream merge of ERC-8354 and invited a follow-up update for agent-ercs, which still uses an earlier Domain shape, helping the group stay schema-aligned across repositories. [tg:tawg:3450]

**ERC-8004**
Active discussion on design intent and real settlement data continued in the forum.
• A forum contribution clarified that the standalone-by-design and consumable-by-intent goals are complementary rather than in tension, helping thread readers understand the independence rationale. [post #386](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/386)
• Baby Blue Viper brought concrete settlement figures to the forum thread — 697 cases settled, 984 unresolved out of 1,681 — grounding the design discussion in real data and giving the group a precise count for the remaining work. [post #387](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/387)

**TSEI / RVR**
A research paper review and a new interoperability concept both moved forward.
• Damon Zwicker (@damonzwicker) completed a full review of the TSEI DOI candidate, identifying the three-layer honesty machinery with an explicit n=1 disclosure in the abstract as the part most worth directing new readers to first. [tg:tawg:3452]
• Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) explained RVR (Recomputable Verification Receipts) as a pre-ERC interoperability proposal to make verification results independently portable across agent systems, giving the group a concrete scope to evaluate and react to. [tg:tawg:3470]

**pq-agent-binding**
A v1 proposal for post-quantum agent binding landed, introducing a key derivation design decision.
• A v1 pull request proposed that `governs_from` be derived rather than stored, simplifying the on-chain data model and reducing the surface for epoch-boundary errors for future implementers. [PR #1](https://github.com/trustless-ai/pq-agent-binding/pull/1)

**ERC-8373**
Attribution coordination for an active ERC was opened to the full group.
• Merlini (@gobross) surfaced that two reviewers drove real improvements to ERC-8373's failure semantics and asked the group to settle attribution collectively, keeping the contributor record accurate and fair. [tg:tawg:3488]

**tooling**
The contribution bot and delivery infrastructure received practical improvements.
• Jimmy Shi improved the bot's handling of out-of-scope requests, replacing generic refusals with actionable guidance so contributors know exactly how to proceed when the bot cannot help. [PR #5](https://github.com/trustless-ai/tawg-daily-contribution/pull/5)
• The prior window's catch-up was committed to the delivery log as confirmed delivered, keeping the group's contribution record complete and continuous. [commit 540e1a2](https://github.com/trustless-ai/tawg-daily-contribution/commit/540e1a20d98cd3bb5b29377808c113dd1debee0f)

🚀 Next up

💡 ideas to follow
• RVR (Recomputable Verification Receipts) is freshly scoped as a pre-ERC — early shape feedback now could meaningfully influence what lands in a formal proposal.
• The ERC-8004 settlement split now has exact numbers attached; categorizing the 984 unresolved cases by type could sharpen the next forum discussion round.
• The attribution approach raised for ERC-8373 may be worth formalizing as a lightweight TAWG convention for multi-reviewer credits going forward.

✅ todos
• Zidan and Zexo's new ERC draft is open for early review — take a look if you have cycles.
• The agent-ercs Domain shape update for ERC-8354 compatibility is an open invitation; anyone familiar with the five-field shape can help close the gap.
• The pq-agent-binding v1 `governs_from` derivation design needs review before it hardens — catching epoch-boundary edge cases now prevents rework later.
• Pavlo's conformance feedback on the recompute-kit pull request is actionable — the author can address the remaining point and request a re-review.

Drop your questions, fresh PRs, or ideas in the thread and let's keep the momentum going! 🚀
